hero.title: From "huh?"
hero.lede: One-on-one math and physics tutoring for grades 7 to 12, online or in North York, with the same tutor every week. Scroll through a lesson, from the question that stumped them to the gold star.

lesson.question: a = 3, b = 4. Find c
lesson.idea: The two short sides squared add up to the long side squared.

stages.c: Every lesson starts with the question from school that didn't make sense. No judgement, just a fresh page.
One idea, drawn out until it clicks. If it doesn't, we draw it a different way.
We solve one together, out loud, every step written down.
They try one on their own. Getting it a bit wrong is part of the plan.
We find the slip together, in red pen, and they put it right themselves.
Six out of six by the end of the hour, and a gold star they actually earned.
